title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Kambia, Karene and Port Loko districts of Sierra Leone, contributes to outcomes 2.1 and 3.1. The objective is that communities in the North-Western Province of Sierra Leone adopt measures and approaches which strengthen their resilience to cope with crises and shocks. Activities include capacity strengthening activities in line with international humanitarian standards; strengthening disaster risk reduction processes; supporting coordination mechanisms at district and national level. The programme is in partnership with Action for Advocacy and Development Sierra Leone. Other partners may be included. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 3.1 Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principle focus of this outcome is:Strengthening disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have Strengthening existing coordination mechanisms in preparation for future emergency response
